name: ChatBI Text2SQL 评估用例集（旧版测试集）
description: 按 cases.json 格式重写的旧版测试用例集，覆盖单表聚合、多表 JOIN、汇率转换、时间范围与毛利计算等场景。

cases.question: 查询欧洲市场最近三个月的总收入
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(o.net_amount) AS total_revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.region = '欧洲' AND o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH);

cases.question: 按大区统计本季度总收入（人民币口径）
cases.golden_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.net_amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS total_revenue_cny FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.order_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY c.region;
rules: 多币种收入按汇率折算人民币
季度固定时间范围使用闭开区间

cases.question: 按产品线统计平均客单价和订单数量
cases.golden_sql: SELECT p.product_line, AVG(o.net_amount) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_line;

cases.question: 查询上个月的销售额、销售成本及毛利
cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(o.net_amount) AS revenue, SUM((p.material_cost + p.labor_cost) * o.quantity) AS cost, SUM(o.net_amount) - SUM((p.material_cost + p.labor_cost) * o.quantity) AS gross_profit FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND o.order_date < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01');
rules: 前1个月使用完整自然月边界
